findings.summary: __attrs_post_init__ calls push_scope(id_of(self.schema)) without checking for None, so schemas without an id push None onto the resolver scope stack, breaking relative $ref resolution (resolution_scope becomes None) and causing the scope stack to grow without being popped.

judge.reason: Identifies unconditional push_scope(id_of(schema)) pushing None, breaking relative ref resolution.

findings.label: hit
